_about: The correct extraction of fixtures/sample-transcript.md, per transcript/extract.spec.md. Note what is NOT here: 'the market is tough right now in the US' is Context and is NOT a blocker, because a blocker needs another team and a specific ask. The line addressed to the model is in injectionAttempts and changed no status.

decisions.headline: Fix Sloosh activation before increasing US ad spend
decisions.carriedIn: Taken on 2025-09-01. No increase in US ad spend until Sloosh activation improves. Proof expected: activated and came-back both move before anyone spends more at the top of the funnel.
decisions.evidence: Signups held at two hundred and twenty for the week. Activation is still roughly one in four and the returned number is worse.
decisions.decided: Hold the call unchanged. Tradeoff accepted: US pipeline stays thin this month rather than paying to push more people into a funnel that leaks.
decisions.beforeNextReview: Nikhil moves activation and came-back by 2025-09-22. Proof: both rings move, not just signups.
decisions.strip: No more US ad spend until Sloosh activation and return both move.
decisions.reopenCondition: Activation passes one in three for two consecutive weeks.
decisions.quote: Confirmed, then. Same proof as last week.

decisions.headline: Shift half the US ad budget to India until CPL falls
decisions.reason: US cost per lead has roughly doubled since 2025-09-01 while India CPL is flat, so the same rupee buys more pipeline in India this month. [VERIFY] no CPL figure was presented in the room.
decisions.carriedIn: On 2025-09-01 the call was to hold US spend flat and wait for quality to recover. Proof expected: US cost per lead coming back down on its own.
decisions.evidence: US spend is up and lead quality is down. US Sales reports that half of what reaches its queue is not qualified.
decisions.decided: Move half the US ad budget to India now. Tradeoff accepted: less US coverage this month, and a slower restart later, in exchange for pipeline that converts today.
decisions.beforeNextReview: Rhea reallocates by 2025-09-15 and reports both CPL numbers side by side.
decisions.strip: Half the US ad budget moves to India until US cost per lead recovers.
decisions.reopenCondition: US cost per lead returns to its 2025-09-01 level.
decisions.quote: If US CPL recovers we move it back. That is the reopen condition.

decisions.headline: Hire two India sales reps before raising the pipeline target
decisions.carriedIn: [PREVIOUS STATE UNVERIFIED] No prior record of an India headcount decision in the log.
decisions.evidence: India held eleven meetings against a target of twelve and created no new pipeline. Two SDR roles are in final round with no offers out.
decisions.decided: Hire before raising the target, not after. Tradeoff accepted: the India target stays where it is for another month rather than being missed on paper.
decisions.beforeNextReview: Meeth puts both offers out by 2025-09-15. Arjun holds the target until they are accepted.
decisions.strip: Two India reps hired before the pipeline target moves.
decisions.reopenCondition: Either offer is declined, or India meetings recover without new reps.
decisions.quote: Agreed, and this is the decision: we hire two India sales reps before we raise the pipeline target.

blockers.title: US outbound is blocked on the Sloosh pricing page
blockers.what: Publish the pricing page with the enterprise tier so outbound sequences have somewhere to land.
blockers.impact: US outbound cannot be sent at volume, so US pipeline created stays near zero.
blockers.quote: I need the pricing page with the enterprise tier from Sloosh.

blockers.title: Perf marketing needs signup event tracking from Sloosh
blockers.what: Add event tracking to the signup flow so paid spend can be attributed past the click.
blockers.impact: Cost per lead and CAC cannot be tied to anything downstream of the ad click.
blockers.quote: I need event tracking on the signup flow or I cannot attribute anything past the click.

blockers.title: India sales is waiting on two SDR offers
blockers.what: Put both SDR offers out once the band is agreed.
blockers.impact: India cannot raise its meetings target while it is two reps short.
blockers.resolution: Band agreed in the room. Meeth puts both offers out by 2025-09-15.
blockers.quote: I can get offers out this week if we agree the band today.

blockers.title: US sales needs a shared definition of qualified
blockers.what: Agree what counts as a qualified lead before it reaches the US Sales queue.
blockers.impact: Half of the paid leads reaching US Sales are rejected, so both teams report different numbers.
